$comment: Lighthouse CI config. See https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci. LCP/CLS use Google Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds; performance score starts at warn=0.85 and will be tightened (or relaxed, with rationale) once we collect ~10 main-branch baseline runs. INP is intentionally omitted — Lighthouse can't measure interaction latency without user actions.
